sentences.en: Toting the weed whip, she cautiously approached the edge of the woods.

sentences.en: Slings and baby carriers offer a more intimate approach to toting baby around.

sentences.en: By toting along a tee and shoes, you'll be ready for a variety of casual, waterside occasions.

sentences.en: You'll be toting pistols, shotguns, carbines, nail guns (which are fun to shoot, but very dangerous), range rifles, and you'll be able to mount cannon turrets for a little mass poundage action.

sentences.en: Also perfect for toting beach gear is the classic canvas beach bag.

sentences.en: Toting Novelty beach towels is a great way to stand out from the crowd, and they also work as a fantastic conversation starter.
sentences.vi: Toting Novelty khăn đi biển là một cách tuyệt vời để nổi bật giữa đám đông và chúng cũng hoạt động như một người bắt đầu cuộc trò chuyện tuyệt vời.

sentences.en: You'll quickly discover that half the items you've been toting around in your handbag serve little day-to-day purpose.
sentences.vi: Bạn sẽ nhanh chóng phát hiện ra rằng một nửa số món đồ bạn thường để ý trong túi xách phục vụ cho mục đích hàng ngày.
